interactions.note: A target behind Total Cover slipped in as one of several targets; must be refused before the slot is spent (R-10).
'Directly': an area spell isn't refused; whether the area reaches is up to area-of-effect (R-10, P-30).

interactions.with: other creatures in the line (allies, enemies, small creatures)
interactions.note: R-09: any creature in the line gives Half, whatever its size, never more; several creatures still give Half.
Cover is worked out per origin and per target; not symmetric, not shared with other attackers.
Best degree only, on attack rolls, spell attacks and Dex saves.

interactions.with: Dexterity saving throws vs other saves (Thunderwave Con save)
interactions.note: The bonus applies to Dex saves only.
Sacred Flame ignores Half and Three-Quarters Cover, not Total Cover.
A refused attack at a target behind Total Cover must not spend the Attack action.
Player-facing path applies the bonus and the refusal.

abuse.case: Attacking or casting a single-target spell at a creature behind Total Cover
Slipping a Total Cover target into a multi-target spell (Magic Missile)
A refused command that still costs the turn (Attack action spent on a Total Cover refusal)
Claiming cover against an attacker on the wrong side
Stacking two degrees of cover (Half + Half, Half + Three-Quarters)
Using an obstruction that covers from one attacker to protect from all
Using a creature as Three-Quarters or Total Cover
Shooting past a small creature as if it gave no cover
Claiming Half Cover from a creature behind the attacker, behind the target or off to the side
Using the Sacred Flame exception to reach a target behind Total Cover
abuse.reason: The exception covers only Half and Three-Quarters

not_testable.reason: The engine models objects only as scene cover labels (half / three-quarters / total) per origin and target. There's no object geometry to decide how much of a target an object covers, so the 'at least three-quarters' threshold can be tested only through the label it maps to.
not_testable.infra_ticket: Scene objects with position and extent, so the engine can work out from geometry how much of a target an object covers (half / three-quarters / whole) and on which side of it an origin lies

summary: This is a revisit of PLAY.combat.cover. The previous report listed only the tests it added, so the gate couldn't see the earlier tests for clauses #1, #2, #4, #7 and #9. This report lists all 50 cover tests in tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py. I added four tests: #7 negative (Three-Quarters Cover doesn't help a Con save), #8 positive (+5 from an object covering three-quarters), #8 boundary (an object covering only half gives +2, not +5) and #10 positive (an object covering the whole target refuses the attack). Every clause now has a positive and a negative test, and every threshold clause also has a boundary test. I also extended CMB-05 with assertions that a creature in the line gives Half Cover. tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py and tests/scenarios/test_combat.py run 78 passed with no xfails, and ruff is clean. The rulings these tests depend on (R-09, R-10, R-11) are already in the register. The only gap left is object geometry: the engine expresses how much of a target an object covers only through scene labels.
